description: This file defines a React context and hooks for managing user authentication state using Supabase. It includes the AuthProvider component, custom hooks for accessing auth data, and functions for signing in with email or Google, as well as signing out.

classes.name: AuthContextValue
classes.description: Type defining the shape of the authentication context, including session info, user info, loading state, and authentication methods.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component providing authentication context to its children.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access the authentication context, throws error if used outside of AuthProvider.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Custom hook to retrieve the current user's role from session metadata.
